answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Interest & Insurance Question ID: 157087 Country: india Title: Can I buy an old bike or car which is initially bought on loan by first or second owner? Question: Can I buy an old bike or car which is initially bought on loan by first or second owner? Answer ID: 157087 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 313/267/D=3/1439) Yes, you may buy the bike from that owner who first bought it on loan provided he has paid the loan himself or he takes the responsibility to pay it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
